raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's innovative approach lies in its "Work Graph," which, instead of building new LLMs, leverages existing foundation models to pinpoint resource expenditure and identify optimal points within workflows for AI assistance, directly addressing enterprises' challenges with AI savings telemetry and ROI measurement.
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies. It has three layers: Observe (Layer 1) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, and time allocation. The Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value of tasks, and "drift" in workflows. The Execution Layer (Layer 3) is an "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. The system utilizes existing foundation models and focuses on a "Work Graph" to identify resource consumption and opportunities for AI intervention.
raw.thesis: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies that aims to enable scalable AI automation. It operates by observing work patterns via desktop sensors (Layer 1), then using an "Intelligence Layer" (Layer 2) to detect employee intent, business value, and workflow drift. Finally, an "Execution Layer" (Layer 3) automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. The core innovation lies in its "Work Graph" approach, which leverages existing foundation models to analyze where resources are being consumed and where AI can be injected into workflows to provide assistance and drive efficiency for enterprises struggling with lack of telemetry, unreliable ROI measurement, and system drift. Narma seeks to replace or significantly augment existing manual observation and process optimization methods, delivering verifiable AI savings and improved workflow adherence. The founder's goal appears to be building a growth-stage startup given the enterprise focus and problem scale. Based on the description of the architecture and layers, the venture is at the concept or prototype stage, with the product being actively built out conceptually, if not yet physically.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited about solving the critical enterprise problem of scaling AI automation by providing granular visibility into work patterns and precise AI agent deployment.
